name: File manipulation
description: Workspace file operations. No network, so these isolate tool-calling accuracy from web flakiness.

tasks.name: create and read back
tasks.goal: Write a file called hello.txt containing exactly the text 'agent was here', then read it back and tell me what it says.

tasks.name: csv generation
tasks.goal: Create a CSV file named fruit.csv with a header row 'name,color' and three rows: apple/red, banana/yellow, grape/purple.

tasks.name: listing and reasoning
tasks.goal: List the files in your workspace and tell me how many there are.
